audit.classification_help: Reads are recorded only for containers listed here. Classifying one as phi also makes a failed audit write refuse the request.
audit.confirm_declassify: Stop recording reads of this container?
audit.no_bucket: No archive bucket is bound, so nothing is archived and nothing is pruned. The audit log is still written and still queryable.
audit.no_bucket_backlog: Events waiting with nowhere to go:
audit.no_classes: Nothing is classified, so no reads are recorded.
audit.review_help: What the trail is showing, and whether the archive still verifies.
audit.signal.bulk_reads_help: One person reading many records from one classified container in a day. The shape exfiltration takes.
audit.signal.contributor_alone: Plugin reads with no accountable user
audit.signal.contributor_alone_help: A plugin read regulated data on its own behalf over the last week. Expected for scheduled work, worth knowing either way.
audit.signal.refused_access_help: Failed sign-ins and denied permission checks in a day. A handful is a misconfiguration; a stream is a probe.

outage.title: Audit outages and reconciliation
outage.help: Review diagnostics and verify external evidence. Saving a review never replays an operation or restores missing history.
outage.unhealthy: Checks require attention or no recent check is available:
outage.incomplete: Diagnostic capture is incomplete; verify the missing evidence independently.
outage.pending: Alert delivery is pending or not configured.
outage.unavailable: The outage journal is unavailable. Do not interpret this as no outages.
outage.disabled: Outage monitoring is not enabled for this deployment.
